$comment: AP7: spotlight balance at a multiplayer table. Over the table's last `window` story lines, each player character's share of the players' lines is counted (NPC and GM lines don't count; out-of-character lines never do). A PC whose share is under `quiet_share` of an even split, or who hasn't spoken in the window, is quiet; the quietest come first (fewest lines, then longest since they last spoke, then name), at most `max_named`. The GM reads one line naming them. Both twins run these cases: client/src/features/campaign/spotlight.ts and server/extensions/ai_campaign/Spotlight.py.

cases.name: an even table has no one quiet
a PC who barely speaks is quiet; NPC, GM and OOC lines don't count
cases.note: Draw in the quieter players: Cole.

cases.name: silent PCs come first, the longest silent first; at most two are named
cases.note: Draw in the quieter players: Bram and Cole.

cases.name: only the last window of lines counts
cases.note: Draw in the quieter players: Bram.

cases.name: one PC, or none, is never anyone to draw in
